# ByeBulky

> Verified ways to get rid of big stuff, city by city. A directory of real options for getting rid of couches, mattresses, furniture and appliances: City bulk and mattress pickup, charities that pick up, drop-off spots, furniture banks and paid haulers.

Every listing comes from the organization's own website or an official government page, links to its sources, and shows the date it was last verified. When a source doesn't state something, the listing says "Not stated, check with them". ByeBulky publishes no reviews or ratings.

## Cities

- [How to Get Rid of a Couch, Mattress or Furniture in Boston (2026 Guide)](https://byebulky.com/boston/): Every verified way to get rid of a couch, mattress, furniture or appliance in Boston: City curbside & mattress pickup, ReStore, furniture banks, and paid…
- [Somerville Bulky Item & Mattress Pickup: 2026 Rules and Options](https://byebulky.com/somerville/): Somerville takes 2 furniture items a week free with trash. Mattresses need a $55 sticker and a 311 appointment; appliances a $25 sticker. All sourced.

## Item guides

- [Get Rid of a Fridge, AC, or TV in Boston (Free Pickup + Donation)](https://byebulky.com/boston/appliances/): Boston picks up fridges, ACs, and TVs free by appointment, but not in the trash. Here are the City's rules, who takes working appliances, and paid haulers.
- [How to Get Rid of a Couch in Boston (Curbside, Donation, Haulers)](https://byebulky.com/boston/couch/): Boston lets you put furniture out with regular trash. Here's how that works, which charities take sofas (and which don't), and paid pickup options, with…
- [How to Get Rid of a Mattress in Boston (City Pickup, Donation & Haulers)](https://byebulky.com/boston/mattress/): Mattresses are banned from Massachusetts trash. Here's how to book Boston's curbside mattress pickup, the rules for 7+ unit buildings, and donation and…
- [Somerville Mattress Pickup: $55 Sticker, 311 & Other Options](https://byebulky.com/somerville/mattress/): Somerville mattress pickup costs $55 per item with a sticker and a 311 appointment by 3:30 p.m. the day before. Rules, limits, donation and hauler options.
